##### Project general facts

The Willows at Sobha Sanctuary is a gracefully planned villa enclave shaped by flowing greens, soft landscapes and a sense of quiet continuity, designed for residents who value calm, connection and a slower, more intentional way of living. The enclave offers four-bedroom Garden Villas in several layouts, including corner and middle homes, all smart-home ready and arranged along landscaped streets with private gardens.

The Willows sits amidst a collection of wellness-focused amenities that support calm, active and balanced living. Forest jogging and cycling loops, yoga and pilates pavilions, meditation sanctuaries and outdoor fitness zones are close at hand, while families enjoy nature-based play areas, botanical gardens and forest-themed parks. A neighbourhood mosque, a clubhouse, a pet zone and smart mobility hubs complete the everyday setting.

Each villa features a private garage, a family living area and a master bedroom with a walk-in wardrobe, with selected layouts adding a maid's room and a roof level. Interiors pair generous glazing with calm, neutral finishes, creating bright living and dining spaces that open towards the garden.

##### Location description and benefits

Sobha Sanctuary is a large master-planned community designed to hold life at scale without losing its sense of quiet, shaped around nature, balance and daily ease. A significant share of the community is devoted to open and green spaces, anchored by a central park and connected by forest walks, shaded trails and green corridors.

Wellness runs through the masterplan with a leisure loop and a dedicated wellness loop for walking and cycling, alongside sports courts, a football field, a tennis court and a cricket ground. Water features include a beach lagoon with a lazy river, a splash pad and sculpted water plazas, while a wellness centre offers hydrotherapy, saunas and steam rooms.

Social life unfolds across community hubs, event lawns, an amphitheatre, co-working spaces and a community mall with walkable retail and farmers' market experiences. Smart mobility and connected cycling networks link every zone, making the community attractive to families seeking a complete, nature-led lifestyle and to investors looking for long-term value.
